en.text: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，天下人的口音、言语都是一样。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，天下人的口音、言語都是一樣。

en.text: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

zhSimplified.text: 他们往东边迁移的时候，在地遇见一片平原，就住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 他們往東邊遷移的時候，在地遇見一片平原，就住在那裏。

en.text: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

zhSimplified.text: 他们彼此商量说：「来吧！我们要做砖，把砖烧透了。」他们就拿砖当石头，又拿石漆当灰泥。

zhTraditional.text: 他們彼此商量說：「來吧！我們要做磚，把磚燒透了。」他們就拿磚當石頭，又拿石漆當灰泥。

en.text: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「来吧！我们要建造一座城和一座塔，塔顶通天，为要传扬我们的名，免得我们分散在全地上。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「來吧！我們要建造一座城和一座塔，塔頂通天，為要傳揚我們的名，免得我們分散在全地上。」

en.text: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华降临，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華降臨，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。

en.text: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：「看哪，他們成為一樣的人民，都是一樣的言語，如今既做起這事來，以後他們所要做的事就沒有不成就的了。

en.text: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们下去，在那里变乱他们的口音，使他们的言语彼此不通。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們下去，在那裏變亂他們的口音，使他們的言語彼此不通。」

en.text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

zhSimplified.text: 于是耶和华使他们从那里分散在全地上；他们就停工，不造那城了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是耶和華使他們從那裏分散在全地上；他們就停工，不造那城了。

en.text: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华在那里变乱天下人的言语，使众人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫。 （代上1·24—27）

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華在那裏變亂天下人的言語，使眾人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫。 （代上1‧24－27）

en.text: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

zhSimplified.text: 的后代记在下面。洪水以后二年，一百岁生了。

zhTraditional.text: 的後代記在下面。洪水以後二年，一百歲生了。

en.text: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了五百年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了五百年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十五岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十五歲，生了。

en.text: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十歲，生了。

en.text: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了四百零三年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十四岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十四歲，生了。

en.text: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了四百三十年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了四百三十年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十歲，生了。

en.text: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了二百零九年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了二百零九年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十二岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十二歲，生了。

en.text: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了二百零七年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了二百零七年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

zhSimplified.text: 活到三十岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到三十歲，生了。

en.text: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了二百年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了二百年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

zhSimplified.text: 活到二十九岁，生了。

zhTraditional.text: 活到二十九歲，生了。

en.text: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 生之后又活了一百一十九年，并且生儿养女。

zhTraditional.text: 生之後又活了一百一十九年，並且生兒養女。

en.text: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

zhSimplified.text: 活到七十岁，生了、、。

zhTraditional.text: 活到七十歲，生了、、。

en.text: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

zhSimplified.text: 的后代记在下面。生、、；生。

zhTraditional.text: 的後代記在下面。生、、；生。

en.text: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

zhSimplified.text: 死在他的本地的，在他父亲之先。

zhTraditional.text: 死在他的本地的，在他父親之先。

en.text: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

zhSimplified.text: 、各娶了妻：的妻子名叫；的妻子名叫，是的女儿；是和的父亲。

zhTraditional.text: 、各娶了妻：的妻子名叫；的妻子名叫，是的女兒；是和的父親。

en.text: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

zhSimplified.text: 不生育，没有孩子。

zhTraditional.text: 不生育，沒有孩子。

en.text: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

zhSimplified.text: 带着他儿子和他孙子的儿子，并他儿妇的妻子，出了的，要往地去；他们走到，就住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 帶着他兒子和他孫子的兒子，並他兒婦的妻子，出了的，要往地去；他們走到，就住在那裏。

en.text: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

zhSimplified.text: 共活了二百零五岁，就死在。

zhTraditional.text: 共活了二百零五歲，就死在。
